description_en: Stops recording a whiteboard operation sequence
description_zh: 结束白板操作序列录制
name: StopWhiteBoardRecording

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the AppID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.help_zh: 白板应用唯一标识符。获取AppID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user (business user) who stops the whiteboard recording. The value is 1 to 32 characters in length and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 结束白板录制的用户ID（客户业务用户），由1~32位大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard document. To obtain the DocKey, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204299.html
parameters.help_zh: 白板文档唯一标识符。获取DocKey，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204299.html
parameters.name: doc_key

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard recording session. To obtain the RecordId, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/253300.html
parameters.help_zh: 白板录制Session的唯一标识符。获取RecordId，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/253300.html
parameters.name: record_id
